title: Local level sets of the Takagi-van der Waerden function
summary: In this paper, we investigate the Takagi-van der Waerden function, $$ T_r(x) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{φ(r^n x)}{r^n} ,\quad x\in [0,1], \quad r \geq 2, $$ where $φ(x)={\rm dist}(x,\mathbb{Z})$ represents the distance from $x$ to the nearest integer. Lagarias and Maddock[13] introduced the notion of local level sets for the classical Takagi function $T_2$. They proved that if $y$ is uniformly distributed over the range of $T_2$, then the expected number of local level sets contained in the level set at height $y$ equals $3/2$.
